name: Tumble Grove
subtitle: A colourful fruit puzzle
promotionalText: Discover a colourful fruit mix every round. Stack and merge, earn optional powers through combos, or tilt your phone to send fruit tumbling around a circular bowl.
description:
A little fruit. A satisfying chain reaction. One more round.

Drop colourful fruit into the basket and bring matching pairs together. Each merge grows a larger fruit, with a gentle reveal that lets you enjoy every step of a cascade. Keep stacking until a fruit spills out.

DISCOVER YOUR NEXT FAVOURITE FRUIT
Explore 110 fruit and variety characters, from familiar favourites to less familiar discoveries. Each round picks a fresh mix across 11 growth levels, favouring a spread of colours. The fruit waiting to drop shows its name, and new merges introduce themselves too. Curious about one already in the basket? Pause with Inspect and tap it to learn its name.

TURN COMBOS INTO A LITTLE MAGIC
Switch on optional Fruit powers to earn rewards from merges anywhere in the basket, including accidental matches. Further drops can join the same combo while the fruit are still reacting. Bigger combos earn stronger powers, and you can save up to three for the right moment.

Choose a matching pair for Gather to pull together, make room with Squeeze, grow a fruit with Ripen, or try Juice, Wild, Rescue and Shake. Gather can target matching fruit of any size within reach; Squeeze shrinks normal fruit of any size inside its preview circle until they next merge. Targeting pauses the basket so you can take your time. Prefer a simple round? Leave powers off.

GIVE GRAVITY A TWIST
Play the classic basket, or switch on Gravity mode and tilt your phone to move fruit around a circular bowl. The opening and drop guide turn with gravity.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Enjoy optional sound, light and dark modes, pause controls and reduced-motion support. Challenge your own best score, tracked separately for each arena with powers on or off.

The complete game works offline, with no account, ads or in-app purchases. Best scores, preferences and fruit-selection history stay on your device. A fresh launch starts a new round; powers are earned during play and last only for that round.

Fruit illustrations are playful interpretations. Real fruit sizes vary by variety and growing conditions.
reviewNotes:
Tumble Grove is a complete offline fruit-merging physics game. All game code, fruit artwork and gameplay resources are included in the app; no login, server or additional download is required.

To play, drag across the arena to aim and release to drop a fruit. Identical fruit merge into the next growth level. New rounds select a different lineup from 110 fruit and variety characters. A round ends when a whole fruit spills outside the basket or through the circular bowl opening. Crossing the dotted guide is allowed.

After dropping a fruit, choose Inspect to pause the game, then tap fruit to see their names. Choose Resume to continue. The moon/sun control changes appearance. Sound is optional.

To test optional powers, enable the Fruit powers switch above the arena. Changing this setting starts a new round and best scores are separate from ordinary rounds. Every merge anywhere in the basket counts toward one combo, including accidental matches. Further drops join that combo while the fruit are still reacting. After about one second of calm, two merges earn one random strength-1 power, three earn strength 2, up to strength 5 for six merges. At six merges the reward is granted immediately; there is only one reward per combo. Powers and any rescued fruit are earned through play, have no monetary value, and cannot be purchased or transferred.

Save up to three powers. Tap a saved power to prepare it or select a target. Targeting pauses play and Cancel preserves the charge. Gather asks for a fruit, then a highlighted matching partner within reach; any fruit growth size is eligible, but obstacles can block the pull. Squeeze previews a circle and shrink percentages, affecting normal fruit of any size whose centre is inside the circle until their next merge. Ripen grows an eligible fruit; Juice removes one; Wild prepares a matching seed; Rescue saves a fruit for a later drop; Shake moves nearby fruit. The UI explains each power's target and strength. Using a power awards any earned natural combo reward first, then the power-assisted reaction gives points but earns no additional powers until the basket settles.

On a physical iPhone, enable Gravity mode and tilt the device to change the direction of gravity. Any requested motion access is used locally for this feature. The classic basket remains playable without motion access.

Best scores, appearance, the powers preference and fruit-selection history are stored locally. The current round and power inventory are not restored after the app process restarts. There are no ads, in-app purchases, accounts, tracking SDKs or developer-operated gameplay servers. Credits, licences, fruit-size research, the privacy policy and support information are available in Help. These information pages are bundled for offline reading. The support page links to the public GitHub Issues tracker, which opens in the system browser. Posting there requires a GitHub account and internet access; posts are public and users are asked not to share personal or sensitive information.
